hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the JSON-LD `datePublished` field on the IMDb page (which indicates when the webpage metadata was generated, 2019) as the film's actual release date, erroneously combining it with the title to conclude a 1991 release. This caused the model to ignore the visible '2019' year in the infobox and draw a false conclusion.
